deviations.what: Removed the 'Get 32% Discount' section and promo code
deviations.why: No offer/promo model exists in Vitrina and the original discount claim is unverified.

deviations.what: Removed the booking form and 'Book a seat' CTA
deviations.why: Vitrina has no booking flow, so the form cannot be represented faithfully.

deviations.what: Removed the 'Hurry Up!' urgency message and the circular hero offer card
deviations.why: The urgency claim is unsupported and the card was tied to the booking CTA.

deviations.what: Removed the two named barbers/team members ('Redo' and 'Sam')
deviations.why: Team content is only allowed with REAL_OWNER_PERSON; no verified owner data exists.

deviations.what: Replaced the three Berlin branch address cards with the AREAS service-area string
deviations.why: The product has no branch-location model, so service areas are the closest supported field.

deviations.what: Swapped the original 'Unbounded' font for Syne and Fira Sans
deviations.why: 'Unbounded' is not in the Vitrina self-hosted font allowlist.

deviations.what: Replaced the embedded Google Map with the shared FindUs component
deviations.why: FindUs is the supported contact/location block in Vitrina.

notes: The JSX is returned unchanged from the current working file. The CSS module is intentionally kept for the next step; it will use `.root :where(a)` resets and responsive `minmax(0, 1fr)` grids to resolve the reported invisible-text and 390px horizontal-overflow issues.
